job.title: Senior Backend Ruby Engineer
job.description:
We are partnering with a growing FinTech in the US who are looking to add a Senior Ruby Engineer to their engineering team. This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates based anywhere in the United States. We're partnering with them to find an experienced engineer who can help design, build, and scale the systems behind their product while mentoring other engineers on the team.

What You'll Do:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Ruby and Ruby on Rails
- Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define technical solutions
- Own features end-to-end, from architecture through deployment and monitoring
- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers
- Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, helping raise the technical bar across the team
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and technical debt
- Contribute to architectural decisions and long-term technical strategy
- Participate in on-call rotation as needed

What Our Client Is Looking For:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time in Ruby and Rails
- Strong understanding of object-oriented design, testing practices (RSpec/Minitest), and clean code principles
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and query optimization
- Familiarity with background job processing (Sidekiq, Resque, or similar)
- Experience with RESTful API design; GraphQL experience a plus
- Comfort working in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools (a plus)
- Excellent written communication skills — critical for a remote, distributed team
- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate proactively across time zones
- Prior experience mentoring or leading technical initiatives

Nice to Have:
- Experience scaling systems handling high traffic or large datasets
- Open-source contributions or a public engineering portfolio
- Experience in FinTech, payments, or other regulated financial environments

job.title: Engineering Manager - Ruby and Rails Infrastructure
job.description:
At Shopify, Engineering Managers drive impact by giving engineers the direction, support, and coaching needed to excel in our Ruby and Rails ecosystem. As the largest Ruby and Rails shop in the world, we're looking for passionate leaders who can combine technical expertise with people leadership to scale the foundational pieces of Shopify's commerce infrastructure.

You'll lead a team of Ruby and Rails experts tackling complex problems that impact not only millions of merchants worldwide, but also the Ruby and Rails open source community.

About the Team:
Shopify's Ruby and Rails Infrastructure team exists to ensure that Ruby and Rails are 100-year tools that will continue to merit being Shopify's toolchain of choice. Our goal is to be stewards of the language and ecosystem, both within Shopify and within the open source community.

Ruby and Rails Infrastructure is split into three subteams: Ruby Infrastructure, Rails Infrastructure, and Ruby Developer Experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing a team of 6-12 individual contributors
- Solving cutting-edge language and framework problems while scaling the largest Rails application in the world
- Collaborating with tech leads to make impactful decisions about how we scale the Ruby language, Rails framework, and our applications
- Balancing technical contributions with people management and leadership responsibilities
- Coaching and growing developers passionate about Ruby and Rails
- Recruiting and hiring excellent candidates to grow the Ruby and Rails Infrastructure team

What You Bring:
- Engineering management experience
- Deep technical expertise in programming language internals or web framework development OR substantial experience managing teams with this kind of expertise
- Experience with Ruby and/or Ruby on Rails is preferred

job.title: Senior Backend Developer
job.description:
Missive brings inbox collaboration to teams that run on email. This isn't your typical SaaS; it's a full-fledged app users live in all day. We integrate with dozens of APIs and servers, process 10M+ emails, 100M+ requests per day serving thousands of users who collaborate in real-time.

Our stack: We keep things simple and that doesn't mean boring. Our backend is a Rails monolith, Postgres, plus a few tiny services in Ruby, Node or Bun.

Must-have "hard skills":
- Ruby proficiency: Write self-documenting and maintainable code, test extensively, adopt latest language features, dig into gem code, monkey-patch responsibly, debug live issues in the console.
- SQL proficiency: Design future-proof schemas, write efficient queries and transactions with careful concurrency control, measure and optimize performance, sample and analyze production data.

Must-have "soft skills":
- Ownership mindset: There are no project managers at Missive. You must keep things moving yourself. Research, scope, design, implement, test and ship autonomously while keeping the team updated and aligned at all times.
- Effective communication: Write clear and concise docs, chats and check-ins. Share video demos as needed. Answer questions before your coworkers ask them.
- Positive energy: Everybody here shares strongly and weakly held opinions with an open mind. We all teach and learn, lifting each other up.

Compensation: Salary: USD $125,000 - $145,000 yearly

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Marketplace Payments
job.description:
Fleetio is looking for a product-minded and team-oriented Senior Software Engineer who is committed to consistently delivering quality software to join our rapidly scaling Marketplace Engineering Team.

Fleetio's Marketplace is a comprehensive platform that facilitates our customers to easily find and purchase a wide range of products and services essential to their fleet operations. Our shop integrations allow our customers to efficiently manage external maintenance activities and get insight into service data. Our Fleetio Pay solution helps Fleet Managers to efficiently manage service work, and provide simple and hassle-free ways to make payments.

In this role on the Marketplace Team you will be responsible for writing maintainable code while implementing new features with an emphasis on connecting customers to maintenance shops, facilitating service, approvals, transactions, billing, and data entry for fleets.

Your Experience:
- 7+ years experience as a software engineer
- 3+ years experience with Ruby on Rails
- 2+ years experience with ReactJS, Typescript
- Firm understanding of object-oriented programming and relational databases such as PostgreSQL
- Expertise with data modeling and optimizing query performance
- Previous experience with payment systems like Stripe, Brex, etc
- Solid experience solving challenging architectural problems with good design
- Experience with unit testing frameworks
- Excellent communication skills (particularly written)

Considered a plus:
- Expertise with consuming and integrating external APIs and/or webhooks
- Experience leading small teams/projects
- Previous experience building APIs for consumer/mobile app consumption
